children.innerHTML: Ember is a 24-seat tasting room cooked entirely over a single open hearth. No gas, no electric, no tricks. Just oak, smoke and time.

attributes.alt: The chef working the pass under copper lamps

Forty days in the dry room, forty seconds on white oak coals.
Rested over the dying fire until the skin turns to lacquer.
Set beside the embers, sauced without apology at the table.
Baked in the falling ash as you sit down.
Leeks held over coals until they give up and turn sweet.
Yesterday's fire, poured over today's bones.
Trout wrapped in fig leaf, steamed on the hearth stone.
The day's beast, aged in-house, finished over oak.
Ewe's cheese under a glass of applewood smoke.
Smoked caramel, burnt honey, a clean spoon.

attributes.alt: Sparks rising off the open fire

children.innerHTML: “Cooking over fire is a conversation. The cook proposes, the fire disposes.”
Elias Voss, chef and keeper of the hearth

meta_description: Ember is a 24-seat tasting room in Shoreditch where every course is cooked over a single open hearth.
